BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc has announced share repurchases totaling 73,836 ordinary shares between June 29 and July 3, 2026, as part of its $250 million buyback program. These shares were acquired on XLON at prices ranging from 1,504.00 to 1,562.00 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 1,545.77 pence for the July 3 purchases. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and since the program's inception on February 26, 2026, Hikma has bought back 9,740,013 shares for a total cost of £131,960,730.15, leaving 212,146,440 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 06 July 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 29 June 2026 to 3 July 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Date within Disclosure Period Trading Venue Aggregate number of ordinary shares repurchased Lowest price paid(pence) Highest price paid (pence) Volume-weighted average price (pence) 1 July 2026 XLON 10,610 1,504.0000 1,511.0000 1,507.4161 3 July 2026 XLON 63,226 1,536.0000 1,562.0000 1,545.7688 The Company intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 9,740,013 ordinary shares at a total cost of £131,960,730.15. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 212,146,440 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 212,146,440.
